General Studies Festival Stall.name: General Studies Festival Stall
General Studies Festival Stall.questStatement: The School Festival is going ahead, barely. Under this year's tight campus security every class stall needs a written plan, a safety check and a teacher's signature, and General Studies has Present Mic. The class is split: half want to boycott a festival they blame the Hero Course for, half want a stall that draws the whole campus. You have to get something planned, approved, built and staffed in time.
General Studies Festival Stall.mainObjective: Get your class's School Festival stall planned, approved, built and staffed in time.

completionCondition.query: The PC's General Studies class has a School Festival stall that Present Mic signed and the security check passed, built and staffed for festival day.

General Studies Festival Stall.questDesignBrief: Comedy of logistics over real resentment. Present Mic signs at full volume and turns plain over security: no open flames without approval, guest-flow plans, no hidden spaces. Hitoshi Shinso keeps his distance or helps quietly. Classmates fight over the boycott and the budget; Mei Hatsume offers lighting nobody should accept. The stall idea is the PC's. Failure: a refused plan goes back for a rewrite, and the stall can open smaller or not at all. Nothing here stages the festival day, Class 1-A's show or any break-in attempt.
